title: Romantic Getaway to Northeast India: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Northeast India. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Northeast India sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Adventure Crew
content:
Northeast India is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Northeast India, the experience is nothing short of transformative. Every corner holds a story, every street a memory waiting to be made. In this guide, we will walk you through everything that makes Northeast India truly special — from its hidden gems to its must-see highlights — so you can plan a trip that feels authentically yours.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Northeast India — bring a blanket and a bottle of wine
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments away from the crowds
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine in intimate, softly lit settings
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets hand in hand

![Romantic Northeast India](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1692652567309-5ac9ae7fe6f7?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Hot air balloon rides over Northeast India provide a magical perspective that you will never forget. Watching the landscape unfold beneath you at sunrise is pure romance.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Northeast India. Splurge on a suite with a balcony for breakfast with a view.

## Planning the Perfect Evening

Surprise your partner with a picnic at one of Northeast India's scenic spots. Local cheeses, fresh bread, and a sunset view make for an unforgettable evening.
